##### Project general facts

Sun Hills Layan is a thoughtfully designed residential development that blends modern architecture with a resort-inspired lifestyle concept. Positioned in a prime location in Phuket, it offers a collection of elegant apartments tailored for both end-users and investors. The development focuses on creating a balanced living environment, combining privacy, comfort, and strong rental appeal. Positioned in a prime location in Phuket, it offers a collection of elegant residences, including stylish studios, spacious one-bedroom, and well-appointed two-bedroom apartments, catering to both end-users and investors.

Residents will benefit from a curated range of amenities designed to support both relaxation and active living. Rooftop infinity pools, lush gardens, a panoramic sunset viewing area, and full resort-style amenities (spa, gym, yoga room, coworking, kids’ center, and a water park) create a vibrant yet relaxed lifestyle environment. Emphasis is placed on creating a tranquil atmosphere, with green spaces and wellness-oriented zones enhancing everyday living. The infrastructure is designed to ensure convenience, security, and a seamless lifestyle experience.

Interiors are delivered with a focus on contemporary elegance and functionality. Apartments feature open-plan layouts, neutral color palettes, and high-quality materials that reflect a refined yet comfortable aesthetic. Units are typically offered fully furnished or turnkey-ready, including fitted kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and modern bathrooms. Attention to detail in finishing ensures a move-in-ready product that aligns with both personal use and rental market expectations.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Thalang District is the largest and one of the most strategically important districts in Phuket, occupying the northern portion of the island. It serves as the gateway to Phuket and is home to Phuket International Airport, making it a highly accessible and well-connected area for residents, tourists, and investors. The district combines rich cultural heritage, established infrastructure, and some of Phuket’s most desirable residential and resort destinations.

The district encompasses a wide variety of communities and lifestyle hubs, including Layan, Bang Tao Beach, Cherng Talay, Surin Beach, and Mai Khao Beach. Thalang is known for its beautiful beaches, protected natural areas, luxury resorts, golf courses, marinas, and international schools, offering a balanced environment for both permanent living and holiday stays.

With its combination of natural beauty, modern infrastructure, and continued real estate growth, Thalang District has become one of Phuket’s most sought-after areas for property investment. Its strong tourism market, expanding residential communities, and strategic location near the airport and major attractions support long-term capital appreciation and excellent rental potential.
